forcedChoices.reason: The mandate goes to all creatures; Spanish forces plural vs singular, and the packet asks for ustedes.

'un tercero' alone reads as 'a third party'; the antecedent is the dual phenomena.

forcedChoices.choice: el Padre de ustedes y el Padre de ellas
forcedChoices.reason: 'su Padre' would not show whose father; ellas agrees with criaturas.
Kept the time/eternity contrast with the next sentence instead of 'con el tiempo' (eventually).
'Deity-realized' needs a preposition in Spanish; 'por' reads Deity as the agent, against other orders that self-realize.
